messages:
alice_support: Hey team — Acme GmbH (acct: acme-eu-42, VAT DE123456789) opened a ticket: their invoice  inv_2026_07_88 shows 19% VAT on a proration charge for an upgrade even though we have a validated VAT ID and PO with tax_exempt=true. Customer is asking for a corrected invoice and root cause.
ben_billing: Can you paste the invoice lines and the original PO metadata? I want to see whether tax_exempt was set on the invoice or only on the customer object.
alice_support: Sure — invoice JSON snippet:
```
invoice_id: inv_2026_07_88
lines: [
  { sku: subscription, amount: 1200.00, tax: 0 },
  { sku: proration_upgrade, amount: 60.00, tax: 11.40 },
]
metadata: { po_number: PO-7784, tax_exempt: "true", billing_country: "DE" }
```
acme_billing: Confirming — we provided PO-7784 and VAT DE123456789 before the upgrade. We expect reverse-charge (no VAT) on B2B EU sales.
cara_acct_mgr: Tagging @dave_platform — customer is upset, can we fast-track a credit note? Also need RCA for postmortem.
dave_platform: I ran a quick audit on the tax engine logs around invoice creation. The proration path calls tax_calc.prorate(...). I see this log: `tax_context: { account_country: GB, billing_country: DE, vat_validated: true, invoice_level_tax_exempt: false }` — invoice_level_tax_exempt=false is suspicious.
ben_billing: That explains it: proration code path was reading `invoice.tax_exempt` rather than `invoice.metadata.po_tax_exempt` which we populate from PO. So proration fell back to account_country (GB) which caused tax to be applied using customer locale.
alice_support: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) create account with billing_country=DE, vat_id=DE123456789 (validated)
2) attach PO metadata {po_number: PO-XXXX, po_tax_exempt: true}
3) simulate upgrade -> creates proration invoice -> tax applied
Logs:
```
CALL tax_calc.prorate(account_id=acme-eu-42)
=> tax_context.invoice.tax_exempt = false
=> tax_engine returns tax_rate = 0.19
```
ben_billing: Confirmed. Looks like a regression from PR #1489 where we refactored invoice metadata mapping and missed using po_tax_exempt flag for proration flow.
dave_platform: Proposed immediate actions:
- Hotfix to prefer invoice.metadata.po_tax_exempt || invoice.metadata.tax_exempt when building tax_context (ETA 2 hours)
- Issue credit note for inv_2026_07_88 for tax amount €11.40 and reissue invoice without VAT (support can request manual credit now)
- Add unit test for proration tax context
cara_acct_mgr: I'll request the credit now and draft customer message. Acme needs confirmation and a corrected invoice by EOD.
alice_support: @taxbot can you generate a quick credit note draft? taxbot: generated draft_credit_cr_2026_07_88 (amount: 11.40 EUR) — awaiting approval.
taxbot: Note: double-check that refund path uses `legacy_refund_flow` for dedicated accounts.
ben_billing: I'll queue the hotfix and the test. After deploy, we'll re-run invoice generation in sandbox to validate.
acme_billing: Appreciate the quick response. Please confirm when corrected invoice is available so we can close PO.
dave_platform: I'll post a deploy note once hotfix is rolled. Also adding a follow-up item to the backlog to audit all proration/trial charge code paths for invoice metadata usage.
alice_support: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer thread and attach the draft credit. :white_check_mark:
